description.value: Pizza 64 is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 2010 with over 20 British Columbia locations, including this Chilliwack outpost on the Lougheed Highway. The menu spans specialty, signature, and gourmet pizzas made with fresh dough and sauce prepared at each location, alongside wings, pasta, and sides. Online ordering for pickup makes it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pizza 64 is an active Canadian pizza chain with online ordering, establishing takeout as a core service. The menu lists multiple vegetarian-only pizzas (Garden Fresh, Pesto Veggie, Passion of India with Tandoori Paneer), supporting a vegetarian amenity claim. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure, so those fields remain null.
